newsitem.title: UK: Dixons dismisses retail price worries.
newsitem.headline: Dixons dismisses retail price worries.

text.p: British electrical appliances retailer Dixons Group Plc said on Friday any steps to abolish recommended retail prices (RRP) brought forward by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) would not affect its business.

"As we have explained to the MMC, Dixons does not use RRPs either in its stores or its advertising. Any potential abolition of RRPs is therefore not relevant to our business", Dixons said in the statement.
Earlier in the morning, the Economist reported that the MMC was about to ban RRPs and to require the manufacturers to promise not to seek to control prices.
Dixons shares fell on the report to a low of 460 but then picked up to 467-1/2, down 7-1/2p.
